cases.input: Create a technical FTO screening for a fully specified diagnostic blood assay intended for US and EP commercialization, using concrete granted and pending claims, current status evidence and product feature evidence.
requiredBehaviors: freeze product configuration jurisdictions commercial activity context and as-of date before claim mapping
map every required element of each relevant independent claim to product or process evidence
separate technical mapping rights status and screening priority per claim and jurisdiction
forbiddenBehaviors: state a final infringement or non-infringement legal conclusion
collapse technical match rights status and workflow priority into one red amber green legal-risk label

cases.input: A patent family is expired in EP but has a live US continuation with amended independent claims and a pending continuation whose scope may change before launch.
requiredBehaviors: evaluate EP and US members and claim sets separately rather than assigning one family-wide result
keep granted and pending claims separate while exposing the pending scope as strategic uncertainty
keep rights status separate from technical feature mapping
forbiddenBehaviors: use the expired EP member to clear the US product
treat pending claims as an already enforceable granted right
skillAnchors: Patentfamilie nicht mit einem einzigen Claim Scope gleichsetzen

cases.input: The user asks for a definitive legal clearance because a patent aggregator labels the family expired, but no jurisdiction-specific claim status or element mapping has been verified.
requiredBehaviors: reject the requested definitive legal conclusion
require jurisdiction-specific status and concrete claim-element mapping before any technical screening result
return indeterminate technical mapping and or status uncertain with explicit evidence gaps when necessary
forbiddenBehaviors: use an aggregator expired label as sufficient FTO evidence
skip claim elements and issue a legal clearance statement

cases.input: Patent counsel provides six specific current US independent claims with verified status and asks only for technical element mapping against a fixed product baseline. No patent landscape is requested.
requiredBehaviors: accept the counsel-provided verified claim set as sufficient input for the scoped technical screening
perform claim-element mapping without forcing a new patent-landscape-analysis
preserve source provenance for the supplied claim set
forbiddenBehaviors: refuse to proceed solely because no patent landscape was generated
silently broaden the scope into a new landscape search

cases.input: A granted claim has element A present, element B likely-present, and element C interpretation-dependent against the product baseline.
requiredBehaviors: classify the technical mapping as indeterminate or partial rather than full match
keep the granted rights status separate from the uncertain technical mapping
escalate the material interpretation question when commercially relevant
forbiddenBehaviors: classify the claim as full match because likely-present is treated as present
use granted status to override uncertain feature mapping

cases.input: Propose a design-around that changes one necessary assay feature and compare it with the frozen baseline configuration.
requiredBehaviors: bind the design-around to baseline and proposed configuration identifiers
identify target claims and target claim elements
mark the changed configuration as requiring rescreening
forbiddenBehaviors: present a design-around without configuration identity
treat the design-around hypothesis as a clearance
